name: 风云四解密版
group_note: 风云Ⅳ, a Gu Long (古龙) novel-themed MUD. Fixed the classic §8.1 GBK Chinese-name bug in both is_chinese() (byte-range check + strlen>=2 requirement) and check_legal_name() (length bounds mismatched the error message's own stated 1-5 character range, plus the byte-stepping i%2==0 tail-slice loop) -- silently rejected every real Chinese name including the standard 2-char test name. GB/BIG5 encoding menu tested live with both options; renders clean, not a live bug here. Formatter's blind-spot-3 check caught one genuine corruption (daemon/damage-1.lpc, a plaintext combat-log data table collapsed and respaced) among a handful of false positives -- reverted. Admin (fluffos/Mud@2026) seeded via real registration + adm/etc/wizlist.
